label: Portraiture Style
description: People-photography style lines — each item is a coherent portrait tradition with its own light and posing logic. Tagged studio/boudoir/street/night so templates keep the style on-genre.

items.name: studio-editorial
items.text: polished studio editorial portraiture, one sculpted key with disciplined fill, immaculate styling and grooming, the confidence of a magazine-cover sitting
items.text_short: studio editorial portraiture, sculpted key, cover confidence

items.name: fashion-flash
items.text: high-energy fashion portraiture, hard on-axis flash against saturated seamless paper, the shadow pinned tight behind the figure, poses angular and deliberate

items.name: beauty-clamshell
items.text: beauty portraiture in tight crop, clamshell light wrapping the face from above and below, skin texture honest beneath the polish, lip and lash detail razor-sharp
items.text_short: clamshell beauty portraiture, honest skin detail

items.name: old-hollywood
items.text: old-Hollywood glamour portraiture, a hot hard key feathered through a fresnel, lacquered waves and satin sheen, every shadow placed like set dressing
items.text_short: old-Hollywood glamour, hard fresnel key, satin sheen

items.name: boudoir-editorial
items.text: editorial boudoir photography, intimacy directed with a fashion eye, a soft directional key falling away into warm shadow, elegance carried by suggestion
items.text_short: editorial boudoir, soft directional key, suggestion over show

items.name: fine-art-figure
items.text: fine-art figure photography, the body treated as sculpture, the long tonal range of a gallery print, composition pared back to line, light and skin
items.text_short: fine-art figure study, gallery tonal range

items.name: quiet-lifestyle
items.text: quiet lifestyle portraiture, believable in-between moments, available light and honest color, the frame left breathing around the subject

items.name: candid-reportage
items.text: candid reportage portraiture, the subject unaware or unbothered, ambient light only, expression caught in the unguarded space between poses
items.text_short: candid reportage, ambient light, unguarded expression

items.name: environmental-portrait
items.text: environmental portraiture, the subject anchored in the place that explains them, mid-distance framing with workplace detail sharing the plane of focus
items.text_short: environmental portrait, subject in telling context

items.name: noir-portrait
items.text: low-key noir portraiture, one hard source and no mercy, highlights rationed to a cheekbone and one eye, everything else surrendered to black
items.text_short: low-key noir portraiture, one hard source
